Take the invoices whose ratio is above the average ratio across all invoices. In a single row, what are their average product cost, their average ratio, and on average how far their ratio sits above that overall average? No rounding. queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / product_price) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
  HAVING AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / product_price) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS avg_diff
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.ratio > overall.avg_ratio;
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_above_overall
FROM inv, o
WHERE inv.ratio > o.avg_ratio;
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         derived_product_cost AS cost,
         CAST(derived_total_cost AS REAL) / product_price AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS r FROM lines
),
inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM lines
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT AVG(avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(avg_ratio - (SELECT r FROM overall)) AS avg_ratio_above_overall
FROM inv
WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT r FROM overall);
